weapon.d:
Accelerates Special trigger (cooldown count-1).
At start of player phase or enemy phase, grants Atk/Res+6,【Time's Gate】, and【Empathy】 to unit and allies within 2 spaces of unit for 1 turn.
If ally initiated combat and【Time's Gate】is active on that ally, grants another action to that ally after combat (if a skill belonging to that ally triggers an effect that grants them another action, such as Galeforce, this effect is treated as not having triggered; if a skill not belonging to that ally triggers an effect that grants that ally another action at the same time as this effect, this effect is also considered to have been triggered; once per turn).
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+15 to unit, unit deals +25 damage (including area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
If unit initiates combat, triggers the following effects depending on unit's equipped Special: if unit has an area-of-effect Special equipped, grants Special cooldown count-X to unit before Special triggers before combat; if unit has a Special that triggers when unit attacks (excluding area-of-effect Specials), grants Special cooldown count-X to unit before unit's first attack during combat (X = the greater value of the number of spaces from start position to end position of unit and the number of turns; max 3).
【Time's Gate】
Allies within 4 spaces of unit can move to a space adjacent to unit (that turn only).
【Empathy】
Grants bonus to unit's Atk/Spd/Def/Res = number of types of Bonus effects, excluding stat bonuses, and Penalty effects, excluding stat penalties, active on player team and enemy team during combat (max 7).

special.d: Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).
Before combat this unit initiates, foes in an area near target take damage equal to 1.5 x (unit's Atk minus foe's Def or Res).

a.d:
Grants Atk/Res+8. Inflicts Def-8.
At start of player phase or enemy phase, neutralizes【Panic】and any penalties to unit's Atk/Res that take effect on unit at this time.
【Panic】
Converts bonuses on unit into penalties through its next action.

b.d: Inflicts Atk-3 on foe through its next action after combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-3 on foe through its next action after combat.
Inflicts Atk/Spd-5 on foe through its next action after combat.

If defending in Aether Raids, after combat for unit or allies on the map, destroys foe's Safety Fence (O) structure (triggers even if unit or ally is defeated in combat).
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 on foe, inflicts penalty on each of those stats = 7 - current penalty on each of those stats (min 0; calculates each stat penalty independently), unit deals +15 damage (excluding area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 15 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).

c.d:
Enables【Canto (Dist.; Max ３, Min １)】.
Disables foe's effects that "calculate damage using the lower of foe's Def or Res" (including area-of-effect Specials).
At start of player phase or enemy phase, if any foes within 3 rows or 3 columns centered on unit have Res < unit's Res+5, inflicts 【Exposure】and【Discord】on those foes through their next actions.
After foes' start-of-turn skills trigger, for the closest foes in cardinal directions of unit, if unit's Res ≥ foe's Res+X (X = distance from unit to foe × 3, -5) and【Time's Grip】is not active on foe, or if it is turns 1 through 3 and unit is defending in Aether Raids during Anima season, foe's action ends immediately and inflicts【Time's Grip】and【Gravity】on foe.
Grants Atk/Spd/Def/Res+5 to unit, unit deals damage = 20% of unit's Res (including area-of-effect Specials), and reduces damage from foe's attacks by 7 during combat (excluding area-of-effect Specials).
【Canto (Dist.; Max ３, Min １)】
After an attack, Assist skill, or structure destruction, unit can move spaces = number of spaces from start position to end position unit moved prior to taking action (max ３; min １; if unit used a movement skill that warped them, unit can move １ space(s).)
【Exposure】
Foe's attacks deal +10 damage.
【Discord】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-X on unit during combat (X = 2 + number of allies within 2 spaces of unit; max 5).
【Time's Grip】
Inflicts Atk/Spd/Def/Res-4 during combat. Neutralizes unit's skills during allies' combat through unit's next action.
【Gravity】
Restricts target's movement to 1 space through its next action.
